goal: Make OCG LAB understandable, crawlable, indexable, and entity-clear for Google Search and AI-assisted discovery without exposing proprietary implementation details.

entity.name: The OCG LAB
entity.description: AI innovation company building intelligent systems, specialized agents, software, guided playbooks, automations, and decision tools for real business workflows.

aiDiscoveryContentRules: State clearly what OCG LAB is and what it builds in visible HTML.
Use specific product and system names with plain-language outcome descriptions.
Separate Available from the Lab from Built by the Lab so machines and visitors can distinguish commercial products from capability examples.

Provide high-level system descriptions that explain purpose and category without publishing prompts, architecture, workflow logic, data models, implementation methods, credentials, or private operating details.
Use strong internal links between company story, capability proof, Atlas, products, and Build With Us.
Keep canonical URLs consistent across metadata, sitemap, structured data, and internal navigation.
Do not rely on llms.txt as a substitute for standard crawlability, indexability, useful content, or structured data.
indexingGate: Do not publish or submit sitemap until the real live source and canonical domain deployment relationship are verified.
